page: UpCloud PREMIUM-64xCPU-384GB is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It features 64 physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is configured with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing 6.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 500 GB SSD. The CPU allocation is shared, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier performance in several areas. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place this instance in the top 10% of tested systems, supported by a PassMark CPU score of 95708.23. Single-threaded gzip compression and both single- and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also rank in the top tier. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is exceptionally high at 8129.22 GB/sec, though large-block uncached read and write memory bandwidths fall into the average tier.

The server is well-suited for high-throughput database operations, static web serving, and medium-scale language model inference. It achieves strong results in PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations, processing 102.43 million operations per second. For LLM workloads, it processes 4527.08 tokens per second for small model prompt processing and 221.55 tokens per second for medium models. Given its high core count and substantial memory capacity, it offers a resource-dense profile for parallel processing and data-intensive workloads, though the shared CPU allocation represents a potential tradeoff for sustained, isolated compute requirements.
